paragraphs: Friend, here's the big idea. God points the way, and it's not a secret. He says, "Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths: 'Where is the good way?' Then walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls." (Jeremiah 6:16) The road to rest was open and the LORD was pointing at it, and they said, "We will not walk in it!"

Here's what hits me. The LORD even appointed watchmen to sound the ram's horn, and the people answered, "We will not listen!" (Jeremiah 6:17) He says the disaster comes because "they have paid no attention to My word and have rejected My instruction." (Jeremiah 6:19) Then He says their offerings "are not acceptable" and their sacrifices "do not please Me." (Jeremiah 6:20) Gifts can't stand in for listening, friend. I can stamp a hundred pretty cookies, but if I ignore the recipe, it's still a pan of mystery.

And that furnace scene is heavy. The fire blasts away and "the refining proceeds in vain, for the wicked are not purged." (Jeremiah 6:29) A heart that keeps saying no can sit in the heat and still come out the same. So the lesson for you today is simple: when God shows you the good way, ask, listen and walk. That's where the rest for your soul is, and I think it's worth the walk, baker.
